critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 3870 lines (was 3434 in iter8) — increasingly urgent to split referral, admin/monetization, and analytics into modules per guideline >700 lines.

referral_me returns paused_reason string unconditionally even when active=true (line 3367/3374). Frontend already checks 'active' flag correctly, but for API consumers this could be misleading. Suggest returning paused_reason='' when active is True.

register-company (/auth/register-company) does not accept referral_code and does not call attribute_referral. If a business goal is to allow companies to be referred (they aren't referrers unless member/launch_free, but they could still be attributed), this is missing. Current requirement only requires companies as referrers, so OK for now.
create_referral_commission (line 3287) swallows all insert exceptions to enforce unique payment_id — could mask unrelated DB errors. Consider catching DuplicateKeyError specifically.

admin cancel subscription (line 1657) does not verify sub is Career Pro before flipping commissions to 'cancelled' — but since commissions are keyed by payment_id and company_membership never creates commissions, effect is null. Still safer to guard by product_type check.
